purpose: Final content-addressed delivery closure, including temporary-worker closure evidence.
rules: Closure binds the pre-closure state, exact choice, final handoff, prepared adapter contract, and any required receipts.
A temporary roster cannot be considered closed without host readback proving zero active temporary workers.
PREPARED has no action receipt; LOCAL_ONLY has a NO_EXTERNAL_ACTION receipt; DEPLOY and RELEASE require live audit; ROLLBACK requires a verified rollback receipt.
Closure is not activation and does not perform a protected action.
